sources.summary: The Roche Diagnostic Innovation Center in Penzberg , Bavaria, is a 35,500 m² research and workplace complex realized for Roche Diagnostics GmbH with an investment of €300 million. The architectural envelope was developed by Nickl & Partner; Studio Alexander Fehre designed the interior architecture across all zones—from the entrance hall through the central atrium and the workplace floors into the highly specialized laboratory areas—creating a continuous spatial language for a building that accommodates approximately 1,000 researchers, scientists, and support staff.
